ruler_evidence.additional_evidence_required: None for the documented equivalent-edge validation; an exact upper-edge ruler photograph would only be required if literal same-endpoint identity is demanded instead of the explicit rectangular-face assumption.

equivalent_edge_assessment.explicit_assumption: The printed front face is modeled as a planar rectangle, so its upper and lower opposite edges have equal physical length.
equivalent_edge_assessment.observed_evidence: The clear photographs show a rigid box front face bounded by four visible straight seams and physical corners; clear2 measures the lower boundary between the left and right side boundaries.
equivalent_edge_assessment.scientific_justification: The assumption is supported by the manufactured box geometry and visible straight boundary/corner structure, but exact right angles and equality are not independently metrologically measured.
equivalent_edge_assessment.validation_scope: The physical result validates the front-face width dimension under this equivalent-edge assumption, not literal identity of the upper-edge pixel endpoints.

ruler_evidence.precision_claim: Only ±1 mm is recorded; no greater precision is inferred.
ruler_evidence.uncertainty_assessment: ±1 mm is plausible for the visible metric ruler reading and corner placement, but it remains physical-measurement uncertainty only and is not a propagated stereo uncertainty.
ruler_evidence.visible_edge_assessment: clear2 shows the lower parallel edge of the printed front face between its left and right outer corners; clear1 and clear3 provide additional ruler views but are less direct for the selected width
ruler_evidence.visible_scale_assessment: clear2 shows a metric centimetre scale labeled 0 cm through the visible range with millimetre subdivisions

secondary_reference.relationship_to_ground_truth: kept separate from the current 96.70 ± 1.00 mm physical measurement
secondary_reference.use: secondary reference information only; not used for calibration, metric scaling, endpoint selection, or acceptance ground truth
